name: kingdom
description: Multi-agent orchestration kit for Claude Code: a King (👑 Opus) coordinates generic workers (👷), co-workers (🧑‍💼), and watchmen (🕵️) — each in its own git worktree on its own branch. Workers are interchangeable capacity; King assigns task scope per-dispatch. Domain-agnostic: code, research, finance, science, manuscripts — anything you version in git. Bootstrap with one command: /kingdom:init scaffolds workspace + project. /kingdom:start <project> spawns the lanes (shape from kingdom.json). /kingdom:update auto-switches to the kingdom integration branch + spawns 4 parallel specialists (Sonnet) + Haiku 🐱 scanner fan-out for fast Layer-1 audits. Per-task multi-layer task files + 4-step closer artifact pipeline make the work auditable.
